title: Design System: O Que Eu Postaria?

display.purpose: The hero question only; extended (125%) black caps.

headline.purpose: Section titles in extended black caps; one-word page names may reach clamp(3rem, 10vw, 8rem).

title.purpose: Hero answer and lead statements, about 26ch.

label.purpose: Condensed (72%) caps for sticker numbers, names, categories, list groups and stats.

shadows.name: sticker-rest
shadows.purpose: Stickers, quote cards, newsletter field at rest.

shadows.name: sticker-lift
shadows.purpose: Hovered/focused and flying stickers, the foil sticker.

shadows.name: slot-recess
shadows.purpose: Empty album slots pressed into the page.

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: Stickers only: drop-in, pack spawn, gluing, sticker/pack hover. Fallback cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1); detector exception recorded in .impeccable/config.json.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Every other transition (buttons 0.25s, link underline 0.3s, gloss sweep 0.8s, viewer 0.45s).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Skips smooth scroll, keyframes, drop-ins and pack flights; stickers appear in place.

components.name: Foil Button
components.description: Primary action: newsletter submit, WhatsApp, section CTAs.

components.name: Line Button
components.description: Tertiary action on any ground, ring in currentColor.

components.name: Newsletter Field
components.description: White pill with inset input and foil submit.

components.name: Header Strip
components.description: Sticky terracotta header: logo and condensed wordmark, growing-underline links, foil WhatsApp.

components.css: .ds-top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1.5rem;min-height:4.25rem;padding:0 1.5rem;background:#ae361b;color:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid rgb(255 255 255/.16);font-family:'Figtree Variable','Figtree',system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-top-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.7rem;margin-right:auto;color:inherit;text-decoration:none}.ds-top-logo{width:2.6rem;height:2.6rem;border-radius:50%;background:#ae361b;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #fff}.ds-label{font-family:'Barlow Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;font-size:1.05rem}.ds-top-nav{display:flex;gap:1.6rem;font-weight:700}.ds-top-nav a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none;padding-block:.4rem;background:linear-gradient(currentColor 0 0) left bottom/0 2px no-repeat;transition:background-size .3s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-top-nav a:hover,.ds-top-nav a:focus-visible{background-size:100% 2px}.ds-top-cta{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.55rem;min-height:2.75rem;padding:.6rem 1.1rem;border-radius:999px;background:#f2c230;color:#17110e;font-weight:800;text-decoration:none}.ds-top a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #f2c230;outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Sticker
components.description: Signature unit: white border, 16:9 well, ink plate with OQEP chip and foil category, gloss sweep on hover.
components.css: .ds-sticker{position:relative;display:grid;margin:0;max-width:16rem;padding:.45rem .45rem 0;background:#fff;border-radius:.6rem;box-shadow:0 .15rem .3rem rgb(0 0 0/.25),0 .9rem 1.6rem -.4rem rgb(0 0 0/.35);color:#17110e;overflow:hidden;rotate:-1.2deg;font-family:'Figtree Variable','Figtree',system-ui,sans-serif;transition:transform .35s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1),rotate .35s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1),box-shadow .25s;--gloss:100%}.ds-sticker::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:inherit;background:linear-gradient(115deg,transparent 35%,rgb(255 255 255/.32) 48%,transparent 60%) var(--gloss) 0/250% 100% no-repeat,linear-gradient(160deg,rgb(255 255 255/.22),transparent 38%);transition:background-position .8s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);pointer-events:none}.ds-sticker:hover,.ds-sticker:focus-visible{transform:translateY(-6px) scale(1.02);rotate:0deg;--gloss:0%;box-shadow:0 .3rem .6rem rgb(0 0 0/.25),0 1.6rem 2.6rem -.6rem rgb(0 0 0/.45)}.ds-sticker:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #f2c230;outline-offset:3px}.ds-sticker-photo{aspect-ratio:16/9;border-radius:.35rem;background:#922b13}.ds-sticker-plate{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;column-gap:.6rem;align-items:baseline;margin:.4rem -.45rem 0;padding:.5rem .65rem .6rem;background:#17110e;color:#fff;line-height:1.15;font-family:'Barlow Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em}.ds-sticker-num{grid-row:span 2;align-self:center;padding:.2rem .4rem;border-radius:.3rem;background:#ae361b;font-size:.75rem}.ds-sticker-name{font-size:.95rem;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.ds-sticker-cat{font-size:.72rem;font-weight:600;color:#f2c230}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-sticker,.ds-sticker::after{transition:none}}

narrative.overview:
The agency is a sticker album you complete. Pages are printed in the logo's terracotta with a faint print grain; work, team and clients are figurinhas with a number, a name and a category, stuck onto the page with a slight tilt. The home is the album's opening spread: cover, collection pages, a printed checklist, the one shiny sticker, and the contact stickers of real people.

Density follows the album. Collection pages are generous grids of uniform stickers on terracotta; checklist pages switch to paper and carry dense, numbered lists with printed check squares. Titles speak in the agency's own portfolio voice: wide, heavy, uppercase. Everything that is "printed on the sticker" speaks in condensed caps.

Motion belongs to the stickers. They drop, spring out of the torn pack and get glued into slots with overshoot; every other surface moves on a calm exponential ease-out. Reduced motion removes the theatre and keeps the content.
keyCharacteristics: Terracotta album pages (#ae361b family) alternating with paper checklist pages and a dark-terracotta page for the team and footer.
White-bordered, rounded stickers with an ink name plate, a terracotta "OQEP nn" number chip and a foil category.
One foil "brilhante" sticker per album; foil otherwise only on primary actions, focus, selection and found-state rings.
Three faces with one job each: Alfa Slab One newsstand headlines, Barlow Condensed plate caps, Figtree for reading.
Spring motion on stickers only; neutral black-alpha shadows.

rules.name: The One Brilhante Rule
rules.body: Exactly one sticker per album is foil (the founder's). Foil appears elsewhere only as an action or state signal: primary button, focus, selection, found ring, plate category text. Never as a section ground or decorative panel.

rules.name: The Logo Ink Rule
rules.body: Terracotta is #ae361b, the logo's color, everywhere it reads as "the brand". Deeper terracottas are its print shadows, not substitutes.

rules.name: The Two Widths Rule
rules.body: Titles are wide (125%), plates are condensed (72%). Body and buttons stay at normal width (100%). Do not introduce a second family; change the width axis instead.

rules.name: The Plate Voice Rule
rules.body: Condensed caps label a thing that exists (a sticker, a slot, a stat, a list group). They are not used as decorative lines above section titles.

rules.name: The Neutral Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are black alpha, never tinted with terracotta or ink. Color depth comes from the terracotta ramp, not from colored shadows.

rules.name: The Gloss Rule
rules.body: Every sticker carries a static diagonal gloss (white at 22-32% alpha); on hover the highlight sweeps across in 0.8s ease-out. Gloss is the sticker's material, not a page effect.

dos: Do present work, people and clients as numbered stickers ("OQEP nn") with an ink plate in condensed caps.
Do keep terracotta (#ae361b) as the page ground for collection pages and switch to paper (#f4f1eb) for dense lists and contact.
Do use the wide 125% black caps for page titles and the 72% condensed caps for anything printed on a sticker or slot.
Do reserve the spring easing for stickers and use the exponential ease-out for every other transition.
Do use black-alpha shadows from the sticker-rest / sticker-lift vocabulary.
Do keep every control a pill and every focus state a 3px foil outline.
donts: Don't add a second foil sticker or use foil as a section background.
Don't put condensed-caps kicker lines above section titles; labels name objects, not sections.
Don't tint shadows with terracotta or ink.
Don't apply spring or overshoot motion to buttons, links, cards or page sections.
Don't add a fourth typeface or fake bold on the slab; vary size, not weight, on Alfa Slab One.
Don't shift the terracotta hue away from the logo color.
